2024_general.fact: Past Election Results page, 'November 5, 2024 Presidential Results': the only unofficial file is 'Unofficial Results (PDF)' (DocumentCenter/View/1179), a county-totals 'Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS', printed 'Election Summary - 11/06/2024 10:35 AM' (CreationDate 2024-11-06 16:38 UTC), after election night. Precinct report 'Official Results Precinct By Precinct' (1177) printed 'Precinct Summary - 11/14/2024 6:04 PM'. CivicPlus DocumentCenter returns Last-Modified equal to request time, so no upload evidence. No election-night file survives; no wayback folder for Bowie (check 3 unavailable).

2026_primary.fact: Elections page 'March 3, 26 Results': 'March 3 2026 Unofficial Results (PDF)' (338) is county totals printed 'Election Summary - 03/04/2026 8:32 AM' (after election night); 'Pct X Pct Democratic' (333) is 'OFFICIAL RESULTS', printed 'Precinct Summary - 03/10/2026 12:39 PM'. 'Joint Primary Preliminary Election' (337) is a scanned image, CreationDate 2026-03-05. No election-night file survives; Last-Modified is request time. Check 3 unavailable (no wayback folder).

2026_runoff.fact: '2026-05-26-Precinct-by-Precinct (PDF)' (600): 'Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS ... 260526 Primary Runoff ... All Ballots', per-precinct with Election Day column (precinct 1A, REP US Senator: Ken Paxton 25 total, 14 Election Day), printed 'Precinct Summary - 05/26/2026 10:33 PM' (CreationDate 2026-05-27 03:34:35 UTC). Companion summary (599) printed 05/26/2026 10:32 PM, 'Election Day Precincts Reporting 38 of 38'. Single election-night precinct report with the final unofficial count. Printed run time only; Last-Modified is request time, so no upload time.

rationale: Only the runoff is determined (END, from an unofficial precinct-by-precinct report printed 10:33 PM election night); 2024 and the primary have only post-election-night files. Exactly one determined election, so PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT, low.
